info.name: Vantage Cloud Pricing Access Grants Costs API

params.name: cost_report_token
params.description: The token of the Cost Report to retrieve costs for.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date for the cost data (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date for the cost data (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: groupings
params.description: Comma-separated list of groupings for cost data.

params.name: vql
params.description: A VQL filter expression to query cost data.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results per page.

items.docs: Returns all Costs for a CostReport or VQL filter. You can filter by cost_report_token or provide a VQL query to retrieve specific cost data.
